about: Masters vault values. Final value = base + age bonus for the gymnast's decade. 'base' is the WG value for WG vaults, or the Masters CoP box value for the Masters-only vaults. The example table is a sample, not every vault; any other WG vault uses its WG value, and a vault in neither the WG Code nor the Masters boxes has base 0.0. Own words; numbers as printed.

rows.vault: Tuck onto table, straight jump off

boxes.cite: Masters WAG CoP p. 2, vault boxes 1-6
boxes.note: Masters-only vaults (not in the WG Code). The example table agrees with them since both were rebuilt on 2026-10-06 (CoP ab38642, planner d1da8b8).

age_bonus.cite: Masters WAG CoP p. 2 (age bonus table); Masters Rules Policy §III.C.2 table

other_vault_base.cite: Masters WAG CoP p. 2 footer; Masters Rules Policy §III.C.3.b

table_wg_vaults.about: the Masters vault table's rows that are WG vaults (no Masters id): the table's description -> the WG WAG vault number(s) it means (two where the row names two vaults, e.g. Tsukahara or Yurchenko). The planner values them from the WG table and checks the table's printed value against it.
table_wg_vaults.cite: our match of the Masters CoP vault table (ucg-code-of-points ucg-masters-vaults.json) to the WG vault table; was the planner's MASTERS_MAP in build_data.py until 2026-10-21
